name: TorrCatalog
overview: TMDB catalogs as virtual libraries, played from torrents via Prowlarr and TorrServer
description: Shows TMDB catalogs (trending, new releases, TV, ...) as virtual movie and TV libraries and plays them through Prowlarr + TorrServer, with a release picker, watch progress and a transcoding fallback. Requires running Prowlarr and TorrServer instances.

versions.changelog: - Add release CI with a Jellyfin plugin repository manifest
